records.name: Save Timetable Draft to Database
records.expected: Timetable draft persisted with generation ID, status COMPLETED, and entries created

records.name: Retrieve Timetable Draft by ID with Entries
records.expected: Returns the exact saved generation with 2 persisted entries

records.name: Update Existing Timetable Draft Entry
records.expected: Entry updated in-place without creating duplicate parent generation
records.actual: Entry bec2d835-8e87-4b01-9e10-d7d04c8d09ad updated successfully: notes="Updated Draft Slot 1 — Rescheduled Room"

records.name: Sequential Generation Numbering Prevents Duplicate Overwrites
records.expected: Re-saving draft generates generation_number = 2 without primary key collision
records.actual: Second generation created safely: generation_number=2, id=05a5d41d-9d2c-4513-b2f2-27661914f5c4

records.name: Delete Draft Timetable Generation Safely
records.expected: Draft generation and its entries deleted cleanly without foreign key violations

records.name: Detect Faculty Double-Booking Conflict
records.expected: Rejects schedule with FACULTY_DOUBLE_BOOKING when same faculty assigned to overlapping periods
records.actual: Detected conflict: Faculty 33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333331 is double-booked on day 1, period 1 across 2 slots

records.name: Detect Classroom Double-Booking Conflict
records.expected: Rejects schedule with CLASSROOM_DOUBLE_BOOKING when same room assigned to overlapping periods
records.actual: Detected conflict: Classroom e0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001 is double-booked on day 1, period 1 for multiple sections

records.name: Detect Section Period Overlap Conflict
records.expected: Rejects schedule with SECTION_PERIOD_CLASH when class section assigned to multiple slots simultaneously
records.actual: Detected conflict: Section c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001 has a schedule clash on day 1, period 1 across 2 subjects/rooms

records.name: Block Unauthorized Student from Publishing Timetable
records.expected: Student cannot publish timetable; status remains DRAFT

records.name: Admin Publishes Timetable with Atomic Metadata and Status Transition
records.expected: Generation marked published in metadata, configuration status = PUBLISHED, notification sent

records.name: Student Can View Published Timetable for Section
records.expected: Student queries published timetable and receives the verified active schedule

records.name: Prevent Direct Modification of Published Timetables
records.expected: Backend and Server Action reject editing published timetables with conflict error
records.actual: Protected: published status enforced, in-place edits rejected

records.name: Unpublish Timetable Reverts Configuration to Draft/Generated
records.expected: Status transitions from PUBLISHED to GENERATED, is_published = false

records.name: Complete 15-Step Timetable Persistence & Publishing Verification
records.expected: All 15 steps succeed with verified database storage, update, publish, and retrieval
records.actual: All 15 steps passed with actual database responses stored in test-results/timetable-persistence/
